facts.text: 1.5% aggregate floating loss: challenge first breach reduces split to 20% for accounts purchased on/after Nov 24 2026, 40% before; second terminates. Instant first breach terminates for newer cohort; pre-Aug 31 first split 40%, second closure. Preserve cohort distinctions; FAQ expressly respects purchase date for min holding duration changes.
